purpose: Describe an unwelcome outcome after a long process.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
give explain a reason cause result
After hours of indecision, I bought nothing.
After repeated discussions, the plan was canceled.
After pushing myself too hard, I ended up damaging my health.
restrictions: Normally evaluates the final outcome negatively.
mistake: Use 末に for a neutral or successful outcome.
